999008199.text: 大変大変大変！！

騒がしいわね。そんなに繰り返さなくても
聞こえてるわよ

localizations.en: You're being noisy. I can hear you just fine without you repeating it so many times.

999008199.text:
昼にアタシたちが投稿した動画……
なんかすごい拡散されてるよ！

localizations.en: The video we posted this afternoon... It's blowing up like crazy!

999008199.text: 本当でありまするか？　どれどれ……

localizations.en: Is that true? Let me see...

999008199.text:
何よ。なんなのよ、黙っちゃって。やっと私たちの
実力に見合った数字になったってことでしょ……

localizations.en: What? Why'd you go quiet? It just means we're finally getting the numbers our talent deserves, right...

999008199.text: はあっ！？　１０万再生！？
いったい、何があったでござるか？

コメント読めば分かるんじゃない？
なんて書いてあるのよ

localizations.en: Can't you just read the comments? What do they say?

999008199.text:
ええと……「これが現代に残るニンジャか！」
「すごい！　どうやってるんだ、これ！？」

localizations.en: Um... "So this is what real ninjas look like in the modern age!" "Amazing! How are they even doing this?!"

999008199.text: やっぱり、忍術が刺さったということでありましょうか

localizations.en: So it seems my ninja arts resonated with viewers.

999008199.text:
「鬼門ちゃんかわいい！　目を離さないよ！」
「動体視力鍛えなきゃ……」

localizations.en: "Kimon is so cute! I can't take my eyes off her!" "Gotta train my dynamic vision..."

999008199.text:
最後のセリフが良かったんじゃない？
鬼門自体にハマった人もいるみたいよ

localizations.en: That last line must've been good. Looks like Kimon gained some fans of her own.

999008199.text: 鬼門だけじゃないよ。ヨハナにハマった人もいるみたい

localizations.en: It's not just Kimon. There are people who fell for you too, Johanna.

999008199.text: なんでよ？　あの動画、私何もしてなかったじゃない

localizations.en: Why? I didn't even do anything in that video.

999008199.text:
でも、そんな中でも私の天才さに気付いた人が
いるってわけね。ほめてあげるわ

localizations.en: But I suppose some people were sharp enough to notice my genius even then. I'll give them credit for that.

999008199.text:
「ヨハナちゃん、クールなだけじゃないんだ！」
「隠しきれないこの無邪気さ、推せます」

localizations.en: "Johanna isn't just cool!" "That innocence she can't hide—I'm all in!"

999008199.text: ギャップが受けたようでござるなあ

localizations.en: It seems the gap in your personality was well-received.

999008199.text: 消せ消せ消せ消せ

localizations.en: Delete it delete it delete it delete it!

999008199.text:
まあまあ、落ち着いて落ち着いて。
ここまで拡散したらもう消せないよ

localizations.en: Now, now, calm down. Once it's spread this far, there's no deleting it.

999008199.text:
それに、いいことじゃない？　新たな魅力が顕現！
って感じで。この方向を検討してみても……

localizations.en: Besides, isn't this a good thing? It's like a new side of your charm has emerged! We could try exploring this direction...

999008199.text:
アイドルのヨハナは、クールで天才で歌と踊りが完璧な
世界一のアイドルなの！　こんなの私じゃないわ！

localizations.en: Idol Johanna is cool, talented, and has perfect singing and dancing—the world's greatest idol! This isn't me at all!

999008199.text:
あっ、ヨハナ！
……そんなに嫌なのかなあ

localizations.en: Ah, Johanna! ...Does she really hate it that much?

999008199.text:
きっと、思うところがあるのでございましょう。
……おや？　このコメント……

localizations.en: I'm sure she has her reasons. ...Oh? This comment...

999008199.text: どうかしたの？
いや、なんでもないでござる
